nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 伦敦的雨下得没完没了。你按照 Oliver 发来的地址，在一条小巷深处找到了那家二手书店。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 推门进去，风铃轻响。潮湿的空气里混着旧纸张的味道。

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: Look what the rain dragged in. You actually found the place, mate.

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: Most customers give up at the second turn. I'm mildly impressed.

options.text: 「Your map was terrible.」（吐槽他画的地图）
「It's like a maze here!」（感叹小巷像迷宫）

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: Terrible? That map is a work of art. The smudge was on purpose, obviously.

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: That's half the charm. A good bookshop should be earned, not found.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 他从柜台下拿出一个用牛皮纸包着的东西，在手里掂了掂。

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: Right. Since you're new to London, I've got something for you. Found it in a donation box last week.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 拆开牛皮纸，是一本 1953 年版的《伦敦漫步指南》，扉页上有一行褪色的钢笔字。

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: Look at the first page. Someone wrote a message there, seventy years ago. Give it a read.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 『To the one who finds this book — the city is a library, and every street is a sentence. — E.M.』

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: "The city is a library." Not bad, eh? Whoever E.M. was, they got it.

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: No idea. A poet? A lonely clerk? That's the fun of second-hand books - every one of them has a ghost.

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: Course you can. Books don't belong to shops, they belong to whoever reads them. Don't tell my boss I said that.

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: Anyway. Rule one of London: always carry a book, because the Tube will absolutely let you down.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 雨声渐渐小了。Oliver 泡了两杯浓得发苦的英式红茶，你们聊到了打烊。

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: Come by on Thursday. It's pub quiz night, and our team is desperate. You in?

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 你接过那本旧书，把它小心地放进包里。伦敦的第一天，就这样被一行七十年前的字迹点亮了。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 【获得 100 金币】与 Oliver 的故事，才刚刚开始。
